evidence.title: 毕沅 《春和园纪游》 明善堂 诗序 (as quoted in S220)
evidence.date: 乾隆; S220 gives no year. Describes Fuheng's garden, so before he gave it up
evidence.locator: S220 section 一; primary not seen
evidence.excerpt_zh: 坐玩鹤亭西望，有石门，如雉堞，东曰归云，西曰舞雪。相羊而入，前跨飞梁，中有曲榭，曰浣香艇。后为清吟书屋，庭列秋槐二株，宵炕昼聂，外有船坞。因命舟师理楫，至锦香亭。白沙如雪，清流玉环，达于明善堂，堂敞七楹，露除霜阙，奎画荧煌。
evidence.summary: A walk through the garden of Fuheng, before Jiaqing rebuilt it. 明善堂 has seven bays, which matches the seven bays of the later 生冬室 on the same site (S43). An older state, not 1860.

evidence.title: Site status table, about 2011: nothing visible, or built over
evidence.summary: Same table. In it the first group shows no visible remains; 得全阁, 流香渚, 凤麟洲, 涵秋馆, 蔚藻堂, 中和堂, 敷春堂 and 心镜轩 have service buildings on them, and 含晖楼, 澄心堂, 延寿寺, 清夏堂 and 喜雨山房 are occupied by other institutions. 澹泊宁静 and several others have been dug since, so this is out of date for them.

evidence.title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v4, editors' note on 鉴碧亭
evidence.summary: Begun in mid-Jiaqing on an islet in the lake west of 迎晖殿, with 正觉寺 to its west: a double-eaved square pavilion, three bays a side, gallery round. On the north of the islet is the five-bay 天心水面 with annexes, and a pavilion 玩鹤. A single-arch stone bridge to the north-east still stands.

evidence.title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v3, editors' note on 得全阁
evidence.summary: Finished 1747 in the south-west: three waterside towers facing east, the main one double-eaved of three bays, plaque 天心水面, with two nine-arch bent wooden bridges; 宝云楼 south and 远风楼 north. Note the same plaque name as the 绮春园 hall QC26.

evidence.title: 圆明园天心水面保护工程考古勘探报告
evidence.summary: Survey 2007, north of 鉴碧亭, water on all sides, edged with stone, three rock piles: 43-86 by 12-81 m, 5872 m2.

evidence.title: 圆明园天心水面保护工程考古勘探报告
evidence.summary: Survey of about 5,872 m2 at 天心水面 Tianxin Shuimian, north of 鉴碧亭, again a waterside site with stone-lined edges, 43-86 m north-south and 12-81 m east-west. Results paywalled.
